title: 16 CFR Part 255 — Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising
excerpts: Specifically, the Guides address the application of section 5 of the FTC Act, 15 U.S.C. 45, to the use of endorsements and testimonials in advertising.
summary: The Guides discuss application of FTC Act section 5 to advertising endorsements and testimonials. Paraphrase.

title: 16 CFR Part 465 — Rule on the Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials
excerpts: It is an unfair or deceptive act or practice and a violation of this part for a business to write, create, or sell a consumer review, consumer testimonial, or celebrity testimonial that materially misrepresents, expressly or by implication:
summary: This provision addresses materially misrepresented consumer reviews and testimonials. Paraphrase.
